value.rationale: This is a complete classification and exact finite-field counting law for the first nontrivial dimension of an explicitly posed linear-endomorphism inverse-monoid problem. The distinction between idempotent and nilpotent isotropy is structural and not a routine substitution into the known transformation-monoid case. It supplies explicit all-field multiplication and two nonisomorphic Brandt components with different groups, motivating extension to higher matrix dimensions.
